name: Kozbi
title: Midianite Woman Killed at Peor
summary: Kozbi was a Midianite woman, the daughter of Sur, a Midianite tribal leader. She was brought into the Israelite camp by Zimri, an Israelite leader, in the midst of a plague that God had sent because of Israel's idolatry and immorality at Baal-Peor. Phinehas, grandson of Aaron, killed both Kozbi and Zimri with a spear, and thus the plague stopped.

keyEvents.title: Israel's Sin at Baal-Peor
keyEvents.description: The Israelites began to commit sexual immorality with Moabite and Midianite women and worship their gods, which aroused God's anger.

keyEvents.title: Zimri Brings Kozbi into the Camp
keyEvents.description: Zimri, a leader from the tribe of Simeon, openly brought Kozbi into the Israelite camp while the people were weeping at the entrance to the Tabernacle.

keyEvents.title: Phinehas Kills Kozbi and Zimri
keyEvents.description: Phinehas, son of Eleazar and grandson of Aaron, followed them into the tent and pierced both of them with a spear, which stopped the plague.

keyEvents.title: The Plague Stops
keyEvents.description: The plague that had killed 24,000 Israelites was stopped as a result of Phinehas' zealous action against Cozbi and Zimri.

keyEvents.title: Cozbi identified as the daughter of Zur
keyEvents.description: Cozbi was identified as the daughter of Zur, a leader of a Midianite clan, which underscored the political dimension of the event.

keyEvents.title: God's command to strike down the Midianites
keyEvents.description: Because of the Midianites' role in leading Israel astray, including through Cozbi, God commanded Moses to go to war against the Midianites.
